title: Flood drill — Dayeuhkolot, Kabupaten Bandung
summary: Twenty-five simulated citizen reports of a Citarum flood at Dayeuhkolot, plus Baleendah, Bojongsoang, a small landslide at Cangkuang Wetan, and two old-photo claims that should stay out of the confirmed cluster.
ethics: All photos are drawn placeholders. Voice files are tones plus transcripts, not field recordings.

reports.text: Banjir di Dayeuhkolot RW 04, air setinggi dada. Satu lansia terjebak di lantai dua dan tidak bisa turun.
reports.translation_en: Flood in Dayeuhkolot RW 04, water at chest height. One elderly person is trapped on the second floor and cannot come down.
reports.transcript: Banjir di Dayeuhkolot RW 04, air setinggi dada. Satu lansia terjebak di lantai dua dan tidak bisa turun.

reports.text: Foto dari Jalan Sukabirus, Dayeuhkolot. Air setinggi pinggang, warung sudah tutup, arus cukup kencang.
reports.translation_en: Photo from Jalan Sukabirus, Dayeuhkolot. Water is at waist height, shops are closed, the current is fairly strong.
reports.transcript: Foto dari Jalan Sukabirus, Dayeuhkolot. Air setinggi pinggang, warung sudah tutup, arus cukup kencang.
Punten, cai di Dayeuhkolot RW 04 geus naek nepi ka dada. Aya kolot nu kejebak di lantai dua, teu tiasa turun. Butuh perahu.

reports.text: Banjir di Jalan Dayeuhkolot, sekitar 40 rumah tangga terendam, kira-kira 160 jiwa. Listrik padam.
reports.translation_en: Flood on Jalan Dayeuhkolot, about 40 households under water, roughly 160 people. Power is out.
reports.transcript: Banjir di Jalan Dayeuhkolot, sekitar 40 rumah tangga terendam, kira-kira 160 jiwa. Listrik padam.
Di Sukabirus cai caah. Budak orok jeung ema-ema nyarande di masjid. Listrik pareum. Mangga dibantosan.
reports.text: Di Sukabirus cai caah. Budak orok jeung ema-ema nyarande di masjid. Listrik pareum. Mangga dibantosan.
reports.translation_en: Floodwater in Sukabirus. Infants and mothers are sheltering at the mosque. The power is out. Please help.

reports.text: PetaBencana report: flood depth about 120 cm in Dayeuhkolot. Road impassable for motorbikes.
reports.translation_en: PetaBencana report: flood depth about 120 cm in Dayeuhkolot. Road impassable for motorbikes.
reports.transcript: PetaBencana report: flood depth about 120 cm in Dayeuhkolot. Road impassable for motorbikes.

reports.text: Grup RW: ulang ya, 40 rumah tangga di Jalan Dayeuhkolot terendam, sekitar 160 jiwa. Mohon logistik.
reports.translation_en: Neighborhood group: repeating, 40 households on Jalan Dayeuhkolot are flooded, about 160 people. Please send supplies.
reports.transcript: Grup RW: ulang ya, 40 rumah tangga di Jalan Dayeuhkolot terendam, sekitar 160 jiwa. Mohon logistik.

reports.text: Warga Dayeuhkolot butuh air minum. Dapur umum belum jalan, anak-anak sudah lapar dari siang.
reports.translation_en: Dayeuhkolot residents need drinking water. The public kitchen is not running yet, and children have been hungry since noon.
reports.transcript: Warga Dayeuhkolot butuh air minum. Dapur umum belum jalan, anak-anak sudah lapar dari siang.

reports.text: Jembatan kecil di Dayeuhkolot tidak bisa dilewati. Akses perahu dari jalan utama masih mungkin.
reports.translation_en: The small bridge in Dayeuhkolot cannot be crossed. Boat access from the main road is still possible.
reports.transcript: Jembatan kecil di Dayeuhkolot tidak bisa dilewati. Akses perahu dari jalan utama masih mungkin.

reports.text: Saya di titik yang sama dengan laporan pertama. Dayeuhkolot RW 04, air masih setinggi dada, lansia di lantai dua belum tertolong.
reports.translation_en: I am at the same spot as the first report. Dayeuhkolot RW 04, water is still at chest height, the elderly person on the second floor has not been rescued.
reports.transcript: Saya di titik yang sama dengan laporan pertama. Dayeuhkolot RW 04, air masih setinggi dada, lansia di lantai dua belum tertolong.

reports.text: 8 lansia terjebak di Masjid Al-Ikhlas Dayeuhkolot, air setinggi dada. Mereka tidak kuat berenang.
reports.translation_en: 8 elderly people are trapped at Masjid Al-Ikhlas in Dayeuhkolot, water at chest height. They cannot swim.
reports.transcript: 8 lansia terjebak di Masjid Al-Ikhlas Dayeuhkolot, air setinggi dada. Mereka tidak kuat berenang.

reports.text: Banjir di Baleendah Andir, air setinggi lutut. Puluhan rumah sudah kemasukan air, jalan utama gelap.
reports.translation_en: Flood in Baleendah Andir, water at knee height. Dozens of houses are inundated, the main road is dark.
reports.transcript: Banjir di Baleendah Andir, air setinggi lutut. Puluhan rumah sudah kemasukan air, jalan utama gelap.
Ngapunten, banyu ing Baleendah Andir wis nganti dengkul. Dalan utama peteng. Ana wong tuwa sing lara, butuh obat.
reports.text: Ngapunten, banyu ing Baleendah Andir wis nganti dengkul. Dalan utama peteng. Ana wong tuwa sing lara, butuh obat.
reports.translation_en: Sorry, the water in Baleendah Andir is already at knee height. The main road is dark. A sick elderly person needs medicine.

reports.text: Foto halaman rumah di Baleendah, air kecokelatan setinggi lutut, sepeda motor tidak bisa keluar.
reports.translation_en: Photo of a yard in Baleendah, brown water at knee height, motorbikes cannot get out.
reports.transcript: Foto halaman rumah di Baleendah, air kecokelatan setinggi lutut, sepeda motor tidak bisa keluar.

reports.translation_en: Duplicate from the group: Baleendah Andir, water at knee height, please log it as one report.
reports.transcript: Duplikat dari grup: Baleendah Andir air setinggi lutut, mohon dicatat satu laporan saja.

reports.text: Puskesmas pembantu Baleendah kehabisan obat untuk lansia. Akses mobil masih putus.
reports.translation_en: The Baleendah sub-clinic is out of medicine for elderly patients. Car access is still cut.
reports.transcript: Puskesmas pembantu Baleendah kehabisan obat untuk lansia. Akses mobil masih putus.

reports.text: PetaBencana: flood report Baleendah, depth about 50 cm, several alleys blocked.
reports.translation_en: PetaBencana: flood report in Baleendah, depth about 50 cm, several alleys blocked.

reports.text: 18 keluarga berteduh di SD Negeri Baleendah. Mereka butuh makanan dan obat, air masih setinggi lutut di sekitar sekolah.
reports.translation_en: 18 families are sheltering at SD Negeri Baleendah. They need food and medicine. Water around the school is still at knee height.
reports.transcript: 18 keluarga berteduh di SD Negeri Baleendah. Mereka butuh makanan dan obat, air masih setinggi lutut di sekitar sekolah.

reports.text: Air mulai masuk ke rumah di Bojongsoang, sekitar 45 jiwa terdampak. Belum ada yang terjebak.
reports.translation_en: Water is starting to enter houses in Bojongsoang, about 45 people affected. Nobody is trapped yet.
reports.transcript: Air mulai masuk ke rumah di Bojongsoang, sekitar 45 jiwa terdampak. Belum ada yang terjebak.

reports.text: PetaBencana: rising water in Bojongsoang, road toward the toll is wet but still open to high vehicles. About 45 people affected.
reports.translation_en: PetaBencana: rising water in Bojongsoang, the toll road is wet but still open to high vehicles. About 45 people affected.
reports.transcript: PetaBencana: rising water in Bojongsoang, road toward the toll is wet but still open to high vehicles. About 45 people affected.

reports.translation_en: Catastrophic flood in Dayeuhkolot, water as high as the houses! Forward this now before it is too late!
